findings.title: The v1.4 approval record is rejected by the candidate validator
findings.reproduction: Run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B tools/ui_conformance.py --repo . --check visual`; approval lineage rejects the legitimate `approval_kind` and `authority` fields.
findings.requiredResolution: Add exact version-aware validation for the v1.4 human-approval authority fields while preserving strict v1.3 validation, with an actual-record regression.

findings.title: Historical visual ratification and deterministic replay remain invalid
findings.reproduction: The authoritative visual check exits 1 after 66 captures, reporting historical package/approval errors for the prior v1.3 lineage. An additional replay reported an index.html dark-theme mismatch while a later isolated render did not.
findings.requiredResolution: Preserve every valid historical ratification independently of the final baseline, validate each snapshot against its cited reference history, and demonstrate repeatable clean exact-candidate visual replay.

findings.title: Post-implementation maintenance accepts arbitrary governed product mutation
findings.reproduction: In a real-Git fixture, include a modified apps/desktop/src/View.tsx with a gate-schema change and exact reviewed GOV-MAINT record; after direct-child adoption, ui_change_gate.validate returns ok=true.
findings.requiredResolution: Require a control-only post-implementation maintenance envelope, reject governed implementation paths, separate product activation changes into task-authorized commits, and add a real-Git mixed-envelope denial test.
